title: Rotate the invoke key and stop storing it in the CloudFront origin header (finding 6)
description: The shared invoke key is the only gate on the Function URL (auth NONE) and is stored in plaintext in the CloudFront distribution config (web-stack.ts unsafeUnwrap), readable by anyone with cloudfront:GetDistributionConfig; it has never been rotated. The owner no longer holds it (PR 504). Rotate it now, then move to an origin scheme that does not store the value in the distribution (for example an IAM-authenticated Function URL with an origin access control).
right_now_summary: The invoke key needs rotation, then CloudFront should switch to a safer authentication scheme.
